messages:
Jon: quick mini-poll — microwave etiquette: do you put a lid/cover on your food or not? vote with one word (lid / no-lid)
Ava: lid 
Priya: no-lid (but foil is an immediate ban) :scream:
Liam: lid — steam = science, also fewer mystery splatters 
Zoe: no-lid — living dangerously, also saves dishwashing time 😅
Jon: ok we have both camps. bonus one-liner: best excuse for a microwave splatter? go.
Ava: 'it was a science experiment' :microscope: 
Priya: 'the container betrayed me' :flushed: 
Liam: 'my lunch is making a dramatic entrance' :theatre_masks: 
Zoe: 'it wanted to be seen' :sparkles: 
Jon: @ops-bot can we get a 10am microwave wipe rota reminder?
ops-bot: Scheduled: microwave-clean reminder set for Mondays at 10:00 (you can react :thumbsup: to volunteer)
Ava: volunteering Monday 10 — I'll bring gloves :gloves: 
Priya: I can take next week Friday morning 
Liam: will leave a sticker on the microwave if I find another rogue lasagna 
Zoe: also, if anyone sees my blue Tupperware with a dent, it's probably adopted a new desk.
Jon: poll tally so far: lid 2, no-lid 2, chaotic neutral 2. conclusion: compromise — lids encouraged, splatter stickers optional. :tada:
